unit_loss.formula: For one contract: (5500−5488) index_point × USD 5/(index_point·contract) × 32 TWD/USD = TWD 1,920 stop loss. Round-trip cost USD 1.50/contract × 32 = TWD 48. Additional 3 index_point beyond stop × USD 5 × 32 = TWD 480. Total stressed loss TWD 2,448/contract.

binding_constraints: TWD 10,000 risk budget; floor(10,000 / 2,448 TWD per contract) = 4 contracts at 1-contract lot step.

scenario_table.scenario: stop + round-trip cost + additional gap stress

assumptions: All values are fictional; multiplier is USD cash per index_point per contract.
FX is TWD per USD. Cost is round-trip cash per contract. Gap amount is additional index_point beyond the stop.
No fill guarantee or execution recommendation is implied.

advisory_proposal.proposal: Four contracts fit this synthetic risk budget under stated assumptions.
advisory_proposal.basis: Computed stressed loss of TWD 2,448 per contract against a TWD 10,000 budget.
advisory_proposal.uncertainty: Synthetic inputs; actual contract spec, FX, costs, gap assumptions and owner limits are unverified.

owner_handoffs: Owner approval required before any portfolio decision or order.
